scope_md:
We'll set up a Missed-Call AI Receptionist for your HVAC business. You keep your current business number and forward unanswered calls to a new US AI line we provision. When you're on a job and can't pick up, the AI answers, and callers who hang up get an automatic text-back so the conversation can continue.

The receptionist collects the caller's name, callback number, service address or ZIP, the type of HVAC job, how urgent it is and their preferred time. It is set up for your service area (77002, 77005 and Houston Heights) and can book appointments directly into your Google Calendar. Because you prefer not to quote prices over the phone, the AI will not give pricing and will take the details for you to follow up instead.

After hours, the line runs in after-hours mode instead of sending callers to voicemail. Emergency keywords, such as no cooling, no heat or a gas smell, trigger an immediate alert to you. You'll get an SMS and email for every lead, plus a daily summary email. We'll load up to 25 FAQ entries along with your business hours.

You'll have a client portal with your call log, transcripts, bookings and settings. We handle the A2P 10DLC SMS registration. Each month we monitor the line, update prompts and FAQs as needed, and handle small change requests one at a time. A Zapier webhook is also available if you want to connect another tool later.
assumptions: One location and one AI line.
Your current phone carrier supports forwarding unanswered or busy calls to the AI line.
Appointments are booked into a single Google Calendar that you give us access to.
The AI will not quote prices; pricing questions are captured as leads for you to follow up.
The line operates in English only.
You will provide your FAQ content, business hours and the list of emergency situations you want flagged.
Your business details are available for A2P 10DLC SMS registration.
timeline_text: Your receptionist will be live within 10 business days after you complete the access checklist, which fits comfortably within your one-month timeline.

includes.name: Missed-Call AI Receptionist
list: 1 location, 1 AI line (a US number we provision; you keep your existing number and forward unanswered calls to it)
Voice answering of missed and forwarded calls, plus an automatic text-back to callers who hang up
Collects job details: name, callback number, service address/ZIP, job type, urgency, preferred time
Booking into 1 calendar: Google Calendar or Calendly
Up to 25 FAQ entries, business hours, after-hours mode, emergency keywords with an owner alert
Owner notifications by SMS and email for every lead, plus a daily summary email
1 outgoing Zapier webhook (lead and booking events) to connect any other tool
English. Client portal with call log, transcripts, bookings and settings
A2P 10DLC SMS registration handled by us (registration fees included)
Included usage per month: 400 voice minutes and 1,000 SMS segments; alerts at 80% and 100%; no automatic overage billing, extra usage blocks added only with your approval
Monthly: monitoring, prompt/FAQ updates, 1 active change request at a time (small changes, up to 1 hour each)

excludes: Outbound AI calls and marketing text messages
Additional locations or AI lines (add-on ADD-LOC)
Usage above the included 400 minutes / 1,000 texts (we alert you at 80% and 100%; extra usage blocks only with your approval)
Call audio recording (calls are transcribed; audio is not stored)
Handling of medical records or other protected health information (no HIPAA BAA)
not_included_extra: Dispatching technicians or deciding in real time whether to send someone out; the AI collects details and alerts you.

refund.guarantee: 30-day satisfaction guarantee: if you're not satisfied within 30 days after go-live, we refund the setup fee and switch the line off. Monthly fees for the period used are not refunded.
refund.deposit: The setup deposit is fully refunded on request within 7 days of payment, as long as the access checklist has not been completed.
